typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_MEME_CK,S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST_137_STAGING S  	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON S.CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID + \'00\' = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER  WHERE M.MEMBER_IID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NonMatchedMembersFromPDSStagingTable
NonMatchedMembersFromPDSStagingTable sink(input(
		Case_ID as string,
		Case_Creation_Date as string,
		MEMBER_SBSB_ID as string,
		MEMBER_MEME_CK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Case_ID = CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CASE_ID,
		Case_Creation_Date = CALLLIST_137_STAGING_CREATE_DATE,
		MEMBER_SBSB_ID = CALLLIST_137_STAGING_SBSB_ID,
		MEMBER_MEME_CK = CALLLIST_137_STAGING_MEME_CK)) ~> NonMatchedErrorFile
